invariant_redesign_root_cause.summary: The v0.7.12 main-loop TIME-exit invariant claimed gross at timestop must be in [-sl_level, +tp_level]. This claim is false: legitimate timestop exits CAN have gross outside this range when the bar JUST BEFORE timestop has high < tp_price (so TP correctly didn't fire) but the timestop bar's open is above tp_price due to an inter-bar gap. The engine fires timestop on the timestop bar even if TP would otherwise hit (per the documented 'Check BEFORE processing TP/SL' design), so this is correct behavior — gross can legitimately exceed tp_level via gap.
